name: juist
comment: Peer-to-peer mesh VPN with no coordination server
desc:
juist is a peer-to-peer mesh VPN with no coordination server. WireGuard
carries the traffic; who belongs to the network is a log signed by its
admins, which every device checks for itself. This package installs the
CLI, the node daemon and its rc.d script.

messages.message: juist: sysrc juistd_enable=YES, then service juistd start
juist: service juistd restart runs the new juistd, and service juist_ingress restart and service juist_serve restart the new helpers where they run
